title: Social Media Marketing Packages and Charges in Kerala (2026)
metaTitle: Social Media Marketing Packages in Kerala | Helix24
metaDescription: What social media marketing packages in Kerala usually include, what affects the price, and how to compare quotes from different agencies.
excerpt: Quotes for social media marketing in Kerala can differ several times over for what sounds like the same service. This guide explains what drives the price and what to compare.
keyTakeaways: What a typical package includes at each level
Why video and paid ads change the price most
Why the ad budget should always be separate from the agency fee

sections.heading: Why quotes vary so much
paragraphs: Two agencies can both offer "social media management" and mean very different things. One may adapt templates and post them; another may plan content, shoot original video and run paid campaigns. The price follows the amount of original work.

sections.heading: What packages usually include
paragraphs: Packages generally fall into three levels. Exact prices differ between agencies, so treat these as descriptions rather than rates.
bulletPoints: Basic presence: a set number of designed posts each month, captions and scheduling. Suits local businesses that mainly need an active, professional page.
Content and video: everything above, plus original photos or Reels, a monthly content plan and replies to comments and messages.
Content plus paid ads: everything above, plus Meta Ads management, audience testing, tracking setup and monthly reporting on enquiries or sales.

sections.heading: What changes the price
paragraphs: A few factors make the biggest difference to what you pay:
bulletPoints: Video: shooting and editing Reels takes far more time than designing posts.
Volume: the number of posts, stories and videos each month.
Ads: managing paid campaigns, testing creatives and reporting adds planning time.
Platforms: Instagram and Facebook together, or more channels.

callout.title: The ad budget is separate
callout.text: Money spent on ads is paid to Meta, ideally from your own ad account and card. The agency fee covers planning, content and management. A quote that mixes the two makes it hard to see what you are paying for.

sections.heading: How to compare quotes
paragraphs: Put each quote side by side and check:
bulletPoints: How many posts and videos you get each month, and who creates them
Whether ads, tracking and reporting are included
Who owns the content, photos and video files
How changes and approvals work, and the notice period

faq.question: Do I need Instagram Reels?
faq.answer: For most consumer businesses, yes. Short video is where Instagram gives the most reach today. A mix of Reels, carousels and stories usually works better than static posts alone.

faq.question: Is organic posting enough without ads?
faq.answer: Organic posts build trust with people who already follow you. To reach new customers consistently, most businesses combine organic content with a modest paid budget.
